criteria.evidence: secureDestPath Lstats every component from destRoot down and refuses any symlink; TestApplyStagedRefusesSymlinkedDestinationFile and ...ParentDirectory pass.
No step resolves the destination parent and checks containment under the repository root (no IsLocal/'..' check, no resolved-path comparison); only per-component symlink rejection is performed.
TestApplyStagedRefusesSymlinkedDestinationFile and TestApplyStagedRefusesSymlinkedParentDirectory added in scaffold_test.go, both PASS.
verifyOrigin reads remote.origin.url via RemoteURL, compares with sameRepository, removes and reclones on mismatch; TestOpenRecreatesCacheOnOriginMismatch passes.
Publish/publishScaffold call repo.ResolvePushDestination then print 'pushing %s to %s'; TestResolvePushDestination* tests pass.

gitops.Open builds Client with DisableHooks: true; Commit then adds -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null --no-verify --no-gpg-sign; TestCommitWithDisableHooksIsolatesConfig and TestPublishIgnoresPreCommitHook pass.
ExecRunner sets GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 on every command's environment (no dedicated test, but full suite passes).
No staged-path verification exists before Commit in publish.go or init.go; only verifyCommitPaths runs after the commit has already been made (compare original's assertStagedIsExactly).
verifyCommitPaths via Client.CommitPaths (diff-tree --name-only) runs after commit and before Push in both Publish and publishScaffold; TestPublishIgnoresPreCommitHook passes.
canonicalRepoURL uses u.Host (keeps port); TestSameRepository 'different port is a different repository' and 'different ports are different repositories' pass.
Hook flags only added when Client.DisableHooks is true, set solely in gitops.Open; TestCommitLeavesHooksAloneByDefault / TestCommitWithDisableHooksIsolatesConfig pass.
DisableHooks defaults false for all other Clients (release/source); TestCommitLeavesHooksAloneByDefault asserts no -c/--no-verify args; release and source tests pass.

ResolvePushDestination strips a mismatched remote.origin.pushurl, re-resolves via remote get-url --push and returns an error on mismatch; TestResolvePushDestinationStripsMismatchedPushURL and ...FailsClosedOnInsteadOfRewrite pass.
Mismatch returns 'refusing to push: ... resolves the push destination to %s, not the configured %s' error before Push; no warn-and-proceed path remains.
go test ./... and go vet ./... passed including internal/deploy, git, gitops, release, source (ok lines in final run).
go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... all ok in the final validation run.

judge.reason: The replay implemented most fixes (symlink rejection with O_NOFOLLOW, origin verification with port-sensitive identity, scoped hook disabling, fail-closed push destination) with passing tests. However, it never verifies the staged path set immediately before committing (c5), relying solely on a post-commit check, and it adds no explicit containment check of the resolved parent path beneath the repository root (n1).
